title: min. | Run Your Own AI Hedge Fund
excerpt: Your personal hedge fund, powered by AI. First research run: free, no signup.
content_html:
min.

Quants that research any idea, trade desk that executes your plan. Your own fund, working for you.

Wall Street keeps this behind velvet ropes. Yours now for free.

Every great fund starts with an idea. Run yours.

first research run free · no signup · tab ⇥ grabs the idea

not a casino, but if it were, you'd want your quant in your pocket

The Big Short, 2015

"Look at him. That's my quant."

The short of the century got sold by pointing at a guy: my quant. My quantitative. My math specialist. Won a national math competition in China. You don't get to question him. That's the whole Wall Street trick: the numbers live behind a guy behind a desk. min. is that guy, in your pocket. Knows the numbers, always shows the work: data sources, backtests, the odds on every investing thesis.

(and he actually speaks English. and he came in second.)

How it works.

01

Call your shot

Any thesis, in plain English. No formulas, no screeners.

02

Deep research, live

An agentic loop pulls live data, filings, and odds. You watch it work.

03

Stress-test it

Backtests and simulations. What's priced in, what breaks the trade.

04

Get the strategy

Sized entries, a schedule, auto-stops. Approve once; min. executes and keeps watch.

under the hood live market data agentic research loops backtesting engines simulations auto-stop watchdogs 70+ research tools

Do the reading.

Burry read the docs. That was the whole trade. min. reads everything, every run.

Be first. Be smarter.

Margin Call gave three ways to win. min. is built for the two legal ones.

Diamond hands, with rules.

Every play ships with a written plan: entries, exits, tripwires. The discipline funds pay pros for, now included.
